checks.name: World Insight native received targets and privacy
No internet sharing without explicit session consent
Historical LOD restored after Minecraft process restart
3D LOD geometry drawn beyond vanilla two-chunk range
LOD is submitted once before vanilla geometry per non-stereo frame
LOD camera axes and screen projection match native terrain
LOD pass preserves valid OpenGL state
Disabling LOD terminates workers and releases all GPU geometry
Re-enabling LOD restores derived cache without resending terrain
Native LAN port is actual bound TCP listener
Shared World Sharing screen is reachable from native adapter
Opening sharing screen never initiates tunnel
LAN remains open after stopping internet sharing
